items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I see him every time I go—he brings back the memories of when I was first over there. I had a good time with him.

ctx.x: I think his name was Tuna Otenel or something like that?
I can’t think of it, but I see him every time I go—he brings back the memories of when I was first over there. I had a good time with him.
